description: The cabin slumps under the weight of snow, its roof caved in on one side. The door hangs askew, and the windows are shattered. Inside, the cold is bone-deep.

environment.noise: silent except for an occasional creak of straining timbers

exits.description: The cabin's heavy door hangs askew on broken hinges, leaning outward into the snow. Through the gap, the frozen lake and glittering white clearing are visible.

items.name: Frozen Corpse
items.description: The body of a hunter, frozen solid.

name: Abandoned Hunter's Cabin
